approach: In scope_guard.rs, drop the quotes link from grouping: remove `RequestRecord::quotes`, its computation and the `ids` binding in `request_records`, and the `.chain(r.quotes.iter())` in `group_lines`. Lines then form only from `retry_of` ("try again on <job>") and `same_text_as` (unchanged same-text re-ask). Update doc comments, the `req` test helper and the quote-based unit test. Add one rig test that drives a naturally paused line, a request citing its jobs, and a retry of it. Update docs/design/scope-guard.md (sections 5, 12 item 1, 13.1) and add a CHANGELOG.md entry.

decisions.choice: Remove the `quotes` field from `RequestRecord` and the id-in-text scan (and the `ids` binding) from `request_records`.
decisions.reason: The field has one use, in `group_lines`. Removing it fixes the root cause (grouping by any id in the text) and leaves no dead data. Any leftover unused field or binding would also fail clippy -D warnings, which criterion 5 checks.

rejected.option: Keep `quotes` populated but skip it in `group_lines`.
rejected.why: Leaves a dead field and a misleading doc; clippy would flag the unread field.

rejected.option: Special-case the refused disk-and-resume request or require 'evidence' words near ids.
rejected.why: Treats the symptom and adds a text heuristic; the default is to remove the rule at its origin.

rejected.option: Add new follow-up syntax such as 'follow up on <job>'.
rejected.why: The accepted reading says the retry link is the explicit follow-up; new syntax is out of scope.

decisions.choice: Test through the real rig (`ask`/`go`, `request_records`, `group_lines`, `line_pause`) with a naturally paused line, plus the updated synthetic grouping unit test.
decisions.reason: The bug lived in the text scan in `request_records`; a pure `group_lines` test over synthetic records could not catch it.

rejected.option: Only update the synthetic `grouping_joins_...` unit test.
rejected.why: It would pass even if `request_records` still linked quoted ids.

decisions.choice: Also edit docs/design/scope-guard.md at the three places that say 'quoting requests'.
decisions.reason: It is a listed deliverable and states the old rule, so it would contradict the code.

rejected.why: It would be stale and is a listed deliverable.

decisions.choice: Criterion 5 demonstration names the concrete failure modes of an incomplete removal and runs the exact Athena check commands.
decisions.reason: Answers the revision finding: fails_without is set for the behavior criterion.

rejected.why: Does not say what fails without the behavior, which the finding requires.

files.purpose: Remove `quotes` field, its computation and the `ids` binding, and the quotes link in `group_lines`; update doc comments, `req` helper and quote-based tests; add the rig test for evidence-citing vs retry requests.
Add a bullet under Unreleased / Fixed: citing job ids as evidence no longer groups a request into that line.
Change 'any request that quotes it' (section 5), 'retries and quoting requests' (section 12 item 1) and 'quoted request ids' (section 13.1) to the retry link plus same-text re-ask rule.

steps: In scope_guard.rs, delete `RequestRecord::quotes` (field at lines 86-87) and the `.chain(r.quotes.iter())` line in `group_lines` (line 118).

Rewrite the doc comment of `group_lines` (line 95): a request, its retries, and any re-ask of the same request text; a job id in a request's text does not join lines. Update the `RequestRecord` and `request_records` docs to drop 'the quoted request ids'. In `request_records`, delete the `quotes: ids...` block (around line 552) and the `ids` binding (line 518) after checking nothing else uses `ids`.

Update the test helper `req(id, retry_of)` (line 1371) and its callers. Replace `grouping_joins_retries_and_quoting_requests` with `grouping_joins_retries_only` (expected `[[0,2],[1],[3],[4]]`). Fix the call in `grouping_joins_a_re_ask_to_the_request_it_repeats`.

Add the rig test next to `retry_refuses_paused_line`: `rig(0.8, 0.01, &[Some(0), Some(0), None])`, ask and go a, then 'try again on {a}' as b. Ask c citing {a} and {b} as evidence with no retry prefix. Assert grouping `[[0,1],[2]]`, `line_pause` None, and that `go(&c)` does not fail with 'paused'. Then ask d = 'try again on {b}', assert `go(&d)` errs with 'paused' and 'T4' and d is in line 0. Read `rig` first to confirm how it consumes the verdict list and adjust it if needed.
Edit docs/design/scope-guard.md at the three places listed; optionally add one sentence in section 5 that a request citing jobs as evidence starts its own line.
Add the CHANGELOG.md bullet under Unreleased / Fixed, naming the 2026-10-28 refusal and noting that a follow-up that only mentions an earlier id now starts a new line.
Run `cargo fmt --all`, `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --locked`.

risks.risk: A genuine follow-up that only mentions the earlier job id (not 'try again on') now starts a new line and does not inherit the attempt count, so T1/T4 fire later for it.
risks.mitigation: This is the requested behavior; the retry link and same-text re-ask still cover real retries. State it in the CHANGELOG entry.

risks.risk: The rig verdict list may not give the third job a verdict as expected, so `go(&c)` ends in an unexpected state.
risks.mitigation: Read `rig` before writing the test; assert that any error from `go(&c)` does not contain 'paused', and assert `line_pause` is None.

risks.risk: Other code may construct `RequestRecord` with `quotes` and break the build.
risks.mitigation: A grep for `quotes` in scope_guard.rs shows uses only at lines 87, 118, 552, 1371-1375; the whole-workspace build is checked in criterion 4.

demonstrations.method: New rig test `citing_a_paused_lines_jobs_as_evidence_starts_its_own_line` in the rig tests module of scope_guard.rs, next to `retry_refuses_paused_line` (line 1167). Setup uses the existing helper `rig(0.8, 0.01, &[Some(0), Some(0), None])` (line 847; fake producer and verifier verdict list, no new seam). Ask and `go` job a, then ask `try again on {a}` as b and `go` it; two same-criterion rejections pause the line naturally (T4). Then ask c with text like `fix disk and resume handling; evidence: jobs {a} and {b} were paused` (no 'try again on' prefix, so retry_of is None). Production entry points: `request_records(&r.records())`, `group_lines`, `Athena::line_pause`, `Athena::go`. No double contains the logic under test.
demonstrations.observes: `group_lines` gives `[[0,1],[2]]`; requests[2].retry_of and same_text_as are None; `line_pause` for c is None; `r.go(&c)` does not return an error containing 'paused'.
demonstrations.fails_without: With the old quotes scan, c joins line [0,1,2], `line_pause` returns Some and `go(&c)` is refused with 'paused'; the grouping and pause assertions fail.

demonstrations.method: Same new test, continued: after c, ask `d = try again on {b}` and call `r.go(&d)`. Also the existing `retry_refuses_paused_line` runs. Entry points `Athena::go`, `line_pause`, `group_lines`; the pause is the natural one from the setup, not injected.
demonstrations.observes: `go(&d)` is Err with text containing 'paused' and 'T4'; `group_lines` puts d in line 0 with a and b; `retry_refuses_paused_line` passes.
demonstrations.fails_without: If grouping dropped the `retry_of` link along with `quotes`, d would start its own line, `go` would proceed, and the refusal assertion would fail.

demonstrations.method: Read the diff of scope_guard.rs and grep it. Check that the `quotes` field, the `quotes: ids...text.contains(...)` block, the `ids` binding and `.chain(r.quotes.iter())` are gone, and that the doc comments on `RequestRecord`, `group_lines` and `request_records` name only the retry link and the same-text re-ask.
demonstrations.observes: The diff shows those removals and the new doc text; no occurrence of `quotes` remains in the file (Grep for `quotes` in scope_guard.rs returns nothing).
demonstrations.fails_without: If the id-in-text link were still there, the diff would still show `quotes` and the text scan, and the criterion 1 test would also fail.

demonstrations.method: Rewrite `grouping_joins_retries_and_quoting_requests` as `grouping_joins_retries_only` using `req(id, retry_of)` (helper at line 1371, quotes parameter removed): a, x, b (retry of a), c (no link), d (retry of a missing id). Expected `[[0,2],[1],[3],[4]]`. Update callers of `req`, including `grouping_joins_a_re_ask_to_the_request_it_repeats`. Run the whole workspace suite.
demonstrations.observes: All workspace tests pass, including the updated grouping tests and every rig test that ran before.
demonstrations.fails_without: The old test, left as written, would not compile against the new `req`/`RequestRecord` or would expect c joined to b; the workspace run would fail.

demonstrations.method: Run the exact checks Athena runs on the result, after the edits. They guard an incomplete removal: a `quotes` field kept but never read, or an `ids` binding left unused in `request_records`, is a dead-code or unused warning that clippy turns into an error; unformatted edits fail fmt. Entry points are the cargo tools themselves; no seam or double is involved.
demonstrations.observes: Both exit 0, with no dead-code or unused-variable warning from the removed field or binding, and no formatting diff.
demonstrations.fails_without: If grouping stopped reading `quotes` but the field or the `ids` binding stayed, clippy -D warnings fails with dead_code/unused_variables; if the edits were not rustfmt-clean, `cargo fmt --check` fails.

demonstrations.method: Read the diff of CHANGELOG.md. Under `## [Unreleased]` / `### Fixed` (existing section near line 28) there is a new bullet saying that citing job ids as evidence no longer groups a request into that line, and that only the retry link and a same-text re-ask do. It names the 2026-10-28 refusal of the disk-and-resume fix and notes that docs/design/scope-guard.md is updated.
demonstrations.observes: Only added lines, with the new Unreleased bullet describing the change.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the entry the diff of CHANGELOG.md is empty.

open_questions: docs/design/hestia.md:256 describes the same old rule ('any request that quotes it') and is not a listed deliverable. Fix in this job or a follow-up?
The verdict list semantics of `rig` (`Some(0)` rejects, `None` lands) were inferred from existing tests, not from reading `rig` in full.
Whether `Records::resolve` accepts an id with trailing text is unchecked; the new test uses 'try again on {id}' with the full id only, as existing tests do.
